records.jp: 詩さん。このキャンプファイヤーね、<CR>ホントに火が点くようになってるんだよ
records.en_original: Uta. We finally managed to get the fire pit working.
records.en: Uta. We finally managed to get the fire pit working.

records.jp: キャンプファイヤー、やったことある？
records.en_original: Have you been to a bonfire party before?
records.en: Have you been to a bonfire party before?

records.jp: 多分……ですが、参加したことは。<CR>ただ……うまく楽しめませんでした
records.en_original: I...think I may have at one time, though I don't think I enjoyed myself.
records.en: I...think I may have at one time, though I don't think I enjoyed myself.

records.jp: あ、分かる気がする。もしかしてさ……
records.en_original: Ahh, I think I get you.
records.en: Ahh, I think I get you.

records.jp: やらされてる感しかなかったんじゃない？<CR>楽しいでしょ、って押しつけがましくてさ
records.en_original: Did it feel a bit forced? Like everyone kept asking you stuff like, "Hey, you having fun?" or, "You're so quiet!"
records.en: Did it feel a bit forced? Like everyone kept asking you stuff like, "Hey, you having fun?" or, "You're so quiet!"

records.jp: …………！<CR>多分、その通りです。どうして……
records.en_original: ...! I think that's true! How did you know...?
records.en: ...! I think that's true! How did you know...?

records.jp: んー。運動会とか卒業式とかもそんな感じじゃん？
records.en_original: Mmm, I think stuff like sports rallies and graduation ceremonies are all kinda like that.
records.en: Mmm, I think stuff like sports rallies and graduation ceremonies are all kinda like that.

records.jp: 私、別に誰とでも仲いいわけじゃないのに、<CR>そーいう時だけ仲間とか友情とか萎えるなぁって
records.en_original: Events like that really show you who your friends are, I think.
records.en: Events like that really show you who your friends are, I think.

records.jp: 私もそんな風に思っていた気がします。<CR>でも、星崎さんが……どうして……？
records.en_original: I think I felt the same. I'm surprised you feel that way, Ao.
records.en: I think I felt the same. I'm surprised you feel that way, Ao.

records.jp: 実はさ、詩さんと話をするようになって、<CR>共感できない気持ちってあれかぁって気が付いたんだ
records.en_original: I kind of realized that I was having trouble relating to others like that when I started talking to you.
records.en: I kind of realized that I was having trouble relating to others like that when I started talking to you.

records.jp: でも……共感ができない私の方が、<CR>きっと変なのかと……
records.en_original: I thought I was the only one like that...
records.en: I thought I was the only one like that...

records.jp: や、誰だって共感押し付けられても、<CR>できないものは普通にできないよー
records.en_original: Everybody has experienced the feeling of having someone else's ideas forced on them.
records.en: Everybody has experienced the feeling of having someone else's ideas forced on them.

records.jp: 詩さん、キャンプファイヤーには<CR>興味なかったんじゃない？
records.en_original: Were you just not very interested in having a bonfire?
records.en: Were you just not very interested in having a bonfire?

records.jp: キャンプファイヤーに限らず……ですが、<CR>私の興味の幅は、かなり小さかったと思います
records.en_original: It's not only that. There aren't many things I have an interest in.
records.en: It's not only that. There aren't many things I have an interest in.

records.jp: 何より、親しくもない人たちと炎を囲んで<CR>みんな楽しそうなのが不気味で……
records.en_original: Most of all, it was strange being with a large group of people I wasn't really close with,<CR>standing by a big fire, pretending to have fun.
records.en: Most of all, it was strange being with a large group of people I wasn't really close with,<CR>standing by a big fire, pretending to have fun.

records.jp: あ、それは分かる気がする。<CR>あんま仲良くない人と隣だと、困るよねー
records.en_original: Ah, I think I know how you feel. Being next to someone you don't get along with is a bit awkward...
records.en: Ah, I think I know how you feel. Being next to someone you don't get along with is a bit awkward...

records.jp: すべて同じではないですが……<CR>星崎さんでも、そんな風に思うんですね
records.en_original: It's not completely the same, but I'm surprised that you agree.
records.en: It's not completely the same, but I'm surprised that you agree.

records.jp: 星崎さんなら、誰とでも楽しめるのかと……<CR>そう、思っていました
records.en_original: I'd thought that you were the kind of person who got along with everyone, Ao.
records.en: I'd thought that you were the kind of person who got along with everyone, Ao.

records.jp: えー。私、そんな出来た人間じゃないって。<CR>フツーにつまんないもんは、つまんないし
records.en_original: Whaat? That's not true at all. Besides, that kind of thing sucks no matter who you are.
records.en: Whaat? That's not true at all. Besides, that kind of thing sucks no matter who you are.

records.jp: そう……なんですか……
records.en_original: I...see.
records.en: I...see.

records.jp: でもさ、ここに来て思ったんだよね。<CR>仲間となら、何だって楽しいんだって！
records.en_original: But since I came here, as long as I'm with the people I love, I can enjoy anything!
records.en: But since I came here, as long as I'm with the people I love, I can enjoy anything!

records.jp: 何でも……ですか？
records.en_original: Anything...?
records.en: Anything...?

records.jp: いや、ケンカだってするけどさ、頭が冷えると、<CR>相手のことがもっと分かった気がして、ほのぼのする<CR>
records.en_original: I mean, we may fight every now and again, but once you calm down you come away from it understanding each other better.
records.en: I mean, we may fight every now and again, but once you calm down you come away from it understanding each other better.

records.jp: ……星崎さんは、やっぱり凄いです。<CR>私とは――
records.en_original: You really are something, Ao. Even with me, you—
records.en: You really are something, Ao. Even with me, you—

records.jp: そんな、詩さんが思ってる程、違わないって。<CR>だって、私と詩さん、ちゃんと話せてるし？
records.en_original: You're not as different as you think, Uta. We're talking normally right now, aren't we?
records.en: You're not as different as you think, Uta. We're talking normally right now, aren't we?

records.jp: それでさ、思ったんだよねー
records.en_original: And so, I was thinking.
records.en: And so, I was thinking.

records.jp: 運動会だってキャンプファイヤーだって、<CR>友達とするなら、きっと楽しかったんだよ
records.en_original: Sports rally, bonfire party, whatever. If you're surrounded by your friends, it's all fun.
records.en: Sports rally, bonfire party, whatever. If you're surrounded by your friends, it's all fun.

records.jp: …………<CR>……そう、かもしれません
records.en_original: ...I think you may be right.
records.en: ...I think you may be right.

records.jp: ……星崎さんは、このキャンプファイヤーに<CR>火を点したいですか？
records.en_original: Would you like to light the fire, Ao?
records.en: Would you like to light the fire, Ao?

records.jp: もちろんだよ！
records.en_original: Heck yeah!
records.en: Heck yeah!

records.jp: 雫世界のキャンプファイヤーの炎、<CR>なにより詩さんに見せたいもん！
records.en_original: I really wanna show you how we do a bonfire here in Oasis!
records.en: I really wanna show you how we do a bonfire here in Oasis!

records.jp: 私に、ですか？
records.en_original: You want to show me?
records.en: You want to show me?

records.jp: うん。詩さんに
records.en_original: Yeah. You, Uta.
records.en: Yeah. You, Uta.

records.jp: 自己満かもだけど、これが私たちの<CR>キャンプファイヤーの炎なんだよーって
records.en_original: I kind of want to show off, you know?
records.en: I kind of want to show off, you know?

records.jp: みなさんの……私たちの、炎……<CR>私も、見てみたいです
records.en_original: I'd like to see it...
records.en: I'd like to see it...

records.jp: 何が何でもってわけじゃないかな。<CR>詩さんに押し付けってしたくないし
records.en_original: Only if you want. I won't force you to do anything.
records.en: Only if you want. I won't force you to do anything.

records.jp: ふふ。星崎さんは、人たらしですね
records.en_original: Hehe. You're sneaky, Ao.
records.en: Hehe. You're sneaky, Ao.

records.jp: えっ！？　人たらし！？
records.en_original: What?! Me, sneaky?!
records.en: What?! Me, sneaky?!

records.jp: 無理強いしないと言って、結局は何かを<CR>押し付けようとする人は、沢山います
records.en_original: Nothing puts pressure on someone like saying you won't force them to do something.
records.en: Nothing puts pressure on someone like saying you won't force them to do something.

records.jp: でも……星崎さんは、本当に私が嫌なら<CR>決して点火しない……そんな気がします
records.en_original: Though... I'm sure you wouldn't ignore me if I said no.
records.en: Though... I'm sure you wouldn't ignore me if I said no.

records.jp: だから……星崎さんが勧めてくれる<CR>キャンプファイヤーの炎、見たいです
records.en_original: That's why... I really want to see this fire that you're so excited about.
records.en: That's why... I really want to see this fire that you're so excited about.

records.jp: ありがと、詩さん。<CR>……じゃ、火を点けるね
records.en_original: Thanks, Uta. I'll light it now.
records.en: Thanks, Uta. I'll light it now.

records.jp: ね、どんな感じ？
records.en_original: So, what do you think?
records.en: So, what do you think?

records.jp: 炎が大きいです
records.en_original: It's a big fire.
records.en: It's a big fire.

records.jp: えー。それだけー？
records.en_original: Aww, that's all?
records.en: Aww, that's all?

records.jp: ふふ。どんな返答を期待しているんですか
records.en_original: Hehe. What kind of answer are you looking for?
records.en: Hehe. What kind of answer are you looking for?

records.jp: んー
records.en_original: Hmmm...
records.en: Hmmm...

records.jp: 詩さんが思ったことなら、何でもー。<CR>詩さんに言わせたい答えなんて、特にないよ
records.en_original: I was just curious to hear your thoughts. There wasn't anything in particular I wanted you to say.
records.en: I was just curious to hear your thoughts. There wasn't anything in particular I wanted you to say.

records.jp: ……暖かいです
records.en_original: ...It's warm.
records.en: ...It's warm.

records.jp: 夏だし、ちょっと暑いかもだけどね
records.en_original: It might be a little too hot if anything... It is the middle of summer.
records.en: It might be a little too hot if anything... It is the middle of summer.

records.jp: 星崎さんが見せてくれようとした炎の色……<CR>とても、暖かく感じます
records.en_original: When I think of how you wanted to show me this. I feel...warm.
records.en: When I think of how you wanted to show me this. I feel...warm.

records.jp: 隣に星崎さんがいることが……暖かいです
records.en_original: Being by your side... It's warm.
records.en: Being by your side... It's warm.

records.jp: 私、暑苦しかった！？
records.en_original: Oops, am I invading your personal space?
records.en: Oops, am I invading your personal space?

records.jp: ふふ。どうでしょうか
records.en_original: Hehe. I wonder...
records.en: Hehe. I wonder...

records.jp: ……大きく燃えていますね
records.en_original: It's burning quite large.
records.en: It's burning quite large.

records.jp: ……だね
records.en_original: ...Yeah.
records.en: ...Yeah.

records.jp: 自分がここにいることを、主張しているように
records.en_original: Almost as if it's affirming it's own existence.
records.en: Almost as if it's affirming it's own existence.

records.jp: あ、それわかる。<CR>でっかい声で、大声上げてるね
records.en_original: I get that. It's almost like it's yelling, "I exist!". I wonder if that's why they say flames roar?
records.en: I get that. It's almost like it's yelling, "I exist!". I wonder if that's why they say flames roar?

records.jp: 嬉しそうにも見えるのは……<CR>ふふ。気のせい、でしょうか
records.en_original: It looks almost...happy. Hehe, that may just be my imagination.
records.en: It looks almost...happy. Hehe, that may just be my imagination.

records.jp: あ……ごめん。<CR>やっぱつまんなかった……よね？
records.en_original: Ah... Sorry. Not very fun after all, huh?
records.en: Ah... Sorry. Not very fun after all, huh?

records.jp: いいえ。そんなことはありません。ただ……<CR>炎って大きかったんだと、改めて気付いたんです
records.en_original: No, it's not that. I just...was reminded of how big flames can get.
records.en: No, it's not that. I just...was reminded of how big flames can get.

records.jp: キャンプファイヤーを楽しむ人たちと、<CR>同じ気持ちになれなくても仕方ありません
records.en_original: It is unfortunate that I was unable to connect with the people at the bonfire that night.
records.en: It is unfortunate that I was unable to connect with the people at the bonfire that night.

records.jp: でも……そこで燃えている炎に<CR>ひとりで見惚れることも、できた筈なんです
records.en_original: But... I realize now that I could have enjoyed myself had I just realized how beautiful the flames were.
records.en: But... I realize now that I could have enjoyed myself had I just realized how beautiful the flames were.

records.jp: あなたは、そうしたことをいつも……<CR>私に教えてくれるんですね
records.en_original: I always learn these kinds of things from you, Ao.
records.en: I always learn these kinds of things from you, Ao.

records.jp: 教えてなんかいないって
records.en_original: I don't really mean to teach you anything...
records.en: I don't really mean to teach you anything...

records.jp: それにさ。ひとりで見るより、<CR>私は詩さんと一緒に見る方が楽しいし、嬉しいよ
records.en_original: I'm glad we could enjoy this together though. It's way more fun with you than just doing it by myself.
records.en: I'm glad we could enjoy this together though. It's way more fun with you than just doing it by myself.

records.jp: で、炎でかいねーとか、ちょっと暑いねーとか、<CR>いろんなことを話したりするの
records.en_original: It's fun talking about the insignificant stuff, like how big the fire is, or hot how it feels.
records.en: It's fun talking about the insignificant stuff, like how big the fire is, or hot how it feels.

records.jp: 暑いけれど……暖かいです
records.en_original: It is very hot...but it's not unpleasant.
records.en: It is very hot...but it's not unpleasant.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
